title: SURROUNDINGS
body:
Situated right where the Viennese plains end and the Alps begin to rise, the commons hub is surrounded by stunning natural sights and a nurturing cultural environment alike.

The Schneeberg and Rax Plateau provide ample opportunities for hiking, biking, rock climbing, rafting, kayaking, swimming and mushroom foraging. Over 2000 alpine climbing routes make the area a prime destination for adventurers and rock climbers from Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and beyond. 

Although its imperial past is long gone, Reichenau an der Rax remains a cultural hub with two musical pavilions and a classical theatre. Its six-week summer festival features two daily plays, along with literature readings, classical music, and other artsy events. Other remnants of the monarchy are various imperial castles, mansions and villas, which account for the noble appearance of the town.

title: HISTORY
body:
The commons hub is housed in the historic Hirschwangerhof, a countryside inn built in 1860. Its history is closely tied to the village of Hirschwang, once a center for the wood and paper industry, and Reichenau an der Rax, an early hub for mountaineering and a Habsburg summer retreat. While the rise of mountaineering by the Viennese Nobility in the late 19th century spurred regional tourism, the past 50 years saw industrial and touristic decline, and the village of once over 2000 inhabitants is currently populated by a mere 200 souls. 

After years of dwindling visitors, the Hirschwangerhof closed in 2008. In 2013, Thomas Fritsch transformed it into an artist colony, which ran until 2017 before the building was vacated. In 2020, Emil Fritsch and the Digital Engineering Association revived the space to host a three-week hackathon and retreat. The following year, Felix Fritsch and Giulio Quarta founded the Crypto Commons Association and organized the first Crypto Commons Gathering. Since then, the Hub has grown steadily, attracting a vibrant community, diverse themes, and events each year.

title: FOUNDATIONS & VISION
body:
FOUNDATIONS

The Commons are shared resources jointly managed by a community according to a set of rules and social norms that ensure sustainable use and equitable access.

Post-Capitalism reorients production from capitalism’s imperative of capital accumulation towards the satisfaction of societal needs within planetary boundaries.

A regenerative future leverages the commons to restore natural ecosystems and repair the damage capitalist alienation has caused to our social fabric.

The liberatory potential of emerging technologies and horizontal social techniques lies in their ability to empower communal self-governance vis-a-vis centralised authority.


VISION

As an experimental playground for post-capitalist systems design, the commons hub explores the liberatory potential of emerging technologies and social techniques that facilitate horizontal communities.

Our aim is to develop a testing ground for the commons that puts these innovations to work,
building a regenerative future in the here-and-now.

This is why our long-term goal is to establish a Valley of the Commons: a place where cooperative housing, cosmo-local production, and systemic resilience converge into a living laboratory of post-capitalism.
summary: a brief overview of our theoretical foundations and the long-vision driving our project

title: COMMUNITY
body:
After four years of growth and countless events,  the community of the commons hub is truly one of a kind. Rooted in the Crypto Commons movement—established and nurtured by the Hub’s co-founder Felix—this network has expanded far beyond its origins. Going beyond crypto, today it integrates influences from permaculture, the arts, mindfulness, conceptual and strategy games, automation, and meta-modernism.

What unites these diverse threads is a shared determination to challenge the status quo: to embark on bold inquiries, embrace unconventional perspectives, ask uncomfortable questions, and maintain independence from funders and other power holders. Against the odds, this community dares to explore and create, not only resisting the mainstream but actively imagining and building alternatives.

These shared experiences of thinking outside the box, confronting adversity, and striving for change have forged deep bonds of solidarity and friendship. Over time, these connections have given rise to a shared worldview: an understanding that the challenges ahead demand collective strength, resilience, and humanity.

Its community makes the commons hub more than a place; it’s a beacon of determination and responsibility. Together, we are committed to building pockets of resistance and resilience—spaces where a new system and society can take root and flourish. This vision of standing together through transformation continues to guide and inspire everything the Hub represents.
summary: Our community is defined by its diversity, sense of communality, and solidarity. Connections formed here often transcend work, evolving into deep and lasting friendships.

title: VALIDATOR NODES
body: The Commons Hub operates the first validator node of the Interchain backed by an intentional, place-based Web3 community. Our ambition for the Cosmos ecosystem is to open pluralistic discussions around culture and politics to steer the evolution of the Interchain towards a democratic, distributed, resilient global infrastructure for the Commons.
